mode: Original Queue WebView login retained; no separate Chrome/CDP to the user's Chrome, no shop-tab architecture change
observedProblem: On the dialog layout the username was typed but the password stayed empty and the order ended as LOGIN_FORM_CHANGED, so the operator had to type the password by hand.
causes: Typed input was not verified: when the page re-rendered the password field mid-typing, the partial or empty value was accepted as done.
A remaining partial value then looked like a changed form, so the job was blocked instead of retrying.
changes: Each field is cleared, typed, then read back; a value that does not match is retyped once from a clean field.
A half-typed value that is only a prefix of what the host types is cleared and retyped once; a value edited by a person is never cleared.
The fill limit is 4 instead of 3, and hitting it records the stage trace in loginView so the next report shows what the window did.
New script helpers ClearUser/ClearPassword/UserValue/PasswordValue with a node test for partial clearing.

nodeTests.newCases: half-typed value cleared before retyping, other field untouched

nativeBuild: passed x64 compile and full native self-tests
nativeInputTests: INPUT_OK offline: 30 trusted key events, 0 untrusted, trusted click, one submit, verified values; LIVE_INPUT_OK on the real /login with a random nonexistent username: both fields typed and verified, trusted click, page answered 'Incorrect username or password.' with no challenge
installation: Staged 1.3.6 in LOCALAPPDATA and D:\BewpakornQueue-1.0.0\extension; release checksums, live extension hashes and installed host hash verified.
preservedData: Ledger and history untouched; the blocked order becomes retryable when the new host starts.
limitations: The exact re-render that cleared the password on this order could not be reproduced without that customer account; the repair path is covered by policy tests and the verified-typing probe rather than a live reproduction.
A challenge, if Roblox decides on one, still needs one human press.
